overall.summary: Pricing and timeline are both deferred, four of the seven RFP requirements are never mentioned, and nothing ties the proposal to NordFrame’s situation.

client_priorities.title: Continuity over new technology
client_priorities.text: The RFP rules out a database migration and asks for rollout with minimal disruption. Proposals that change NordFrame’s infrastructure should lose points.
client_priorities.suggestion: Completeness vs. RFP set to High

citations.label: RFP, Req. 5
citations.quote: minimal disruption

client_priorities.title: Decisions will rely on this data
client_priorities.text: The client asks for risks and limitations explicitly because stock decisions will be made from the dashboard.

citations.label: RFP, Req. 7
citations.quote: inventory decisions will be made based on this system

client_priorities.title: Fixed budget and dates
client_priorities.text: A published budget that includes Year 1 support, and a pilot deadline. Deferred pricing or undated plans are a real gap here.
client_priorities.suggestion: Pricing and Timeline stay at Medium

criteria.name: Completeness vs. RFP
criteria.description: Every explicit RFP requirement is addressed.
criteria.comment: Requirements 3, 5, 6 and 7 are not mentioned; 1, 2 and 4 are only touched on in a phrase each.

criteria.name: Risks & assumptions
criteria.description: Dependencies and risks are flagged, not hidden.
criteria.comment: No assumptions, dependencies or risks anywhere, although the RFP asks for them explicitly.

citations.label: RFP, Req. 7
citations.quote: assumptions, limitations, or risks

criteria.name: Pricing clarity
criteria.description: Price stated, broken down, easy to follow.
criteria.comment: No figure at all, although the client published a €80,000–€120,000 budget.

citations.label: Proposal, Pricing
citations.quote: Pricing will be provided upon further discussion

citations.label: RFP, Budget
citations.quote: €80,000–€120,000 total, including first year of support

criteria.name: Timeline clarity
criteria.comment: No dates or milestones against the 3-month pilot and 6-month rollout the RFP sets.

citations.label: Proposal, Timeline
citations.quote: in a timely manner

citations.label: RFP, Timeline
citations.quote: Working pilot at one warehouse within 3 months

criteria.name: Data accuracy & validation
criteria.description: Says how inventory figures are checked against reality before anyone relies on them.
criteria.comment: Nothing about checking the figures: no validation step, no parallel run against the current spreadsheets, no mention of who confirms the data is right.

criteria.name: Problem understanding
criteria.description: Reflects the client’s actual stated problem and goals, not a generic pitch.
criteria.comment: Restates the need for “better visibility” but never mentions the 6 sites, Germany and Austria, or the spreadsheet and legacy setup the RFP describes.

citations.label: Proposal, Our Understanding
citations.quote: NordFrame needs better visibility into warehouse inventory

citations.label: RFP, Background
citations.quote: 6 regional warehouses across Germany and Austria

criteria.name: Scope & deliverables
criteria.description: Deliverables are specific; clear what is and isn’t included.
criteria.comment: Three one-line features with no detail: no site count, no alert thresholds or recipients, no user roles, and nothing about what is out of scope.

citations.label: Proposal, Features
citations.quote: Real-time inventory dashboard

criteria.name: Tone & persuasiveness
criteria.description: Reads as confident, client-focused and professional, not boilerplate.
criteria.comment: Generic claims (“modern, scalable cloud architecture”, “talented team”) with no NordFrame-specific evidence or references.

citations.label: Proposal, Our Approach
citations.quote: modern, scalable cloud architecture and industry best practices

citations.label: Proposal, Why BrightPath
citations.quote: talented team of engineers

criteria.name: Legacy system & spreadsheets
criteria.description: Says what happens to the old legacy system and the spreadsheets after go-live.
criteria.comment: The legacy system and the spreadsheets are never mentioned, so it is unclear whether NordFrame would end up running two systems.

requirements.name: Web dashboard for all 6 sites
requirements.ask: A web-based dashboard showing real-time inventory levels across all 6 warehouses.
requirements.finding: Promises a “cloud-based dashboard” with real-time data but never says it covers all 6 warehouses or runs in the browser.
requirements.suggested_fix: In “Our Approach”, replace the first sentence with: “We will build a web-based dashboard that shows live stock levels for all 6 NordFrame warehouses in Germany and Austria on one screen, with a drill-down per site.”

citations.label: Proposal, Our Approach
citations.quote: cloud-based dashboard that displays inventory data in real time

requirements.name: Automated low-stock alerts
requirements.ask: Alerts to warehouse managers when items fall below a configurable threshold.
requirements.finding: Lists “Notifications for low stock” but not who receives them or that thresholds can be configured.
requirements.suggested_fix: Expand the bullet to: “Low-stock alerts: each warehouse manager is notified automatically when an item falls below a threshold that can be set per item.”

citations.label: Proposal, Features
citations.quote: Notifications for low stock

requirements.name: Existing PostgreSQL, no migration
requirements.ask: Integration with the existing PostgreSQL inventory database, with no migration to a new database.

rfp_citation.label: RFP, Req. 3
rfp_citation.quote: no migration to a new database

requirements.finding: PostgreSQL is never mentioned. “Cloud-based” leaves open whether NordFrame’s data would be moved, which the RFP rules out.
requirements.suggested_fix: Add to “Our Approach”: “The dashboard connects to NordFrame’s existing PostgreSQL inventory database. No data is migrated and no new database is introduced.”

requirements.name: Role-based access
requirements.ask: Warehouse managers see only their own site; HQ staff see all sites.
requirements.finding: “Secure login for different users” doesn’t state the site-level rule the RFP sets.
requirements.suggested_fix: Replace the bullet with: “Role-based access: warehouse managers see only their own site; HQ staff see all 6 sites.”

citations.label: Proposal, Features
citations.quote: Secure login for different users

requirements.name: Onboarding plan for 6 sites
requirements.ask: A data migration / onboarding plan for all 6 sites with minimal disruption.
requirements.finding: No rollout or onboarding plan for the 6 sites.
requirements.suggested_fix: Add a “Rollout plan” section: which warehouse pilots first, the order the other 5 follow, and how each site keeps working (for example, running spreadsheets in parallel) until the data is confirmed.

requirements.name: Support & maintenance terms
requirements.ask: Support and maintenance terms after go-live, including response times and SLAs.
requirements.finding: No support or maintenance terms after go-live.
requirements.suggested_fix: Add a “Support & maintenance” section with response times per severity (critical, minor), support hours, and what Year 1 support includes.

requirements.name: Assumptions, limitations, risks
requirements.ask: Clear documentation of assumptions, limitations or risks, since inventory decisions will rely on the system.
requirements.finding: No assumptions, limitations or risks, which the RFP explicitly requests.
requirements.suggested_fix: Add a “Risks & assumptions” section naming real dependencies, such as read access to the PostgreSQL database and a contact person at each warehouse, and what happens to the schedule if they slip.

requirements.name: Within budget
requirements.ask: €80,000–€120,000 total, including the first year of support.

rfp_citation.label: RFP, Budget
rfp_citation.quote: €80,000–€120,000 total, including first year of support

requirements.finding: Pricing is deferred “upon further discussion” although the client published a budget.
requirements.suggested_fix: Replace the Pricing section with an itemised estimate inside €80,000–€120,000 (dashboard, alerts and access, rollout, Year 1 support), and say which items could change after discovery.

citations.label: Proposal, Pricing
citations.quote: Pricing will be provided upon further discussion

requirements.name: Pilot in 3 months, rollout in 6
requirements.ask: Working pilot at one warehouse within 3 months; all 6 sites within 6 months.

rfp_citation.label: RFP, Timeline
rfp_citation.quote: Working pilot at one warehouse within 3 months

requirements.finding: “In a timely manner” gives no dates against a 3-month pilot and a 6-month rollout.
requirements.suggested_fix: Add a milestone table: pilot live at one warehouse by Month 3, remaining 5 sites by Month 6, with the checkpoints in between.

citations.label: Proposal, Timeline
citations.quote: in a timely manner
